issue: E and the on-screen NPC interaction button stop working after development rebuild/reload

reproducedBeforeFix.sequence: Connect, transport drop, reconnect successfully, reload
reproducedBeforeFix.result: The saved reconnection token is expired. Resume fails and the fallback join is denied by the reserved profile lease; the page becomes offline and both NPC entry points are disabled.
reproducedBeforeFix.cause: SDK 0.18.5 invokes onReconnect before assigning the newly rotated reconnectionToken. The application persisted the previous token in that callback.

reproducedBeforeFix.sequence: Connect, restart the fixture backend without reloading the page
reproducedBeforeFix.result: The old room disappears and the application stays in error instead of recovering the profile.

changes: Defer the application reconnect callback until the handshake finishes, so ProfileSession remembers the new token.
Opt Hằng Nhạc into bounded recovery after an unexpected room termination: resume first, then join the same saved profile when the old room no longer exists.
Stop recovery on explicit leave/suspend and on authentication or profile lease denial; do not replay quest, reward or supply commands.
Show connection recovery in the objective panel, enable interaction only for a connected actor, and reject an unavailable send instead of silently dropping the command.
Expose connection detail and pending NPC request diagnostics without logging account or reconnection tokens.

verification.assetWritesThenReload: 3 passes; E and on-screen button; same saved profile; no manual refocus
verification.transportReconnectThenReload: 3 passes; E and on-screen button; same session and saved profile
verification.backendRestartWithoutPageReload: passed; same profile; E and on-screen button
verification.explicitLeaveDuringRecovery: passed; remains offline after backend returns; active session cleared
verification.skillWithoutNpcQuestGrant: one confirmed sword cast with HN01/HN02 incomplete; existing R01 rights retained
verification.existingSectRegression: test:hang-nhac-sect passed: proximity, IME, HN01/HN02, timed cycle, M01, supplies, trio, persistence and mobile
verification.r01BrowserRegression: passed: all three skills, keyboard/buttons, costs, hits, dash, remote FX, reload, account lease, character switch and mobile
verification.r01Harness: Use a smaller desktop viewport for two software-rendered clients and record rendered peer FX each frame before screenshot latency can outlive the effect. Wait for the first player snapshot before reading diagnostics; failure output now includes state and service logs.
verification.livePreview: Existing 127.0.0.1:5173 profile re-entered and reloaded successfully; 105 casts/15 hits and HN02 progress retained; three skill buttons ready. The live player is outside NPC range; NPC dialogue was verified in the isolated fixture.
verification.storage: Isolated fixture SQLite, browser context and publicDir. No seeding/resetting owner profile, map or editor draft.

limits: Recovery retries are bounded; after exhaustion or server denial the player gets an error and can join manually.
Three R01 skills are available from the saved starting profile; an NPC dialogue is not an unlock requirement.
This is connection/NPC regression coverage, not an MMO capacity or ART approval claim.
